issues.issue: Did the IAD err in concluding Ms. Ukhueduan was not a member of the PDP before 2011?
issues.applicant_position: IAD imposed a new active-member threshold; any admitted membership counts, so she was a member from 2006.
issues.respondent_position: Argued no 2006 membership appears in her forms; supported the IAD view that pre-2011 involvement was not active membership.
issues.result_quote: the IAD’s analysis and conclusion is clearly inconsistent with the jurisprudence regarding the unrestricted and broad interpretation of the term

issues.issue: Did the IAD err in applying a temporal component to whether the PDP engaged in acts under paragraph 34(1)(f)?
issues.applicant_position: Paragraph 34(1)(f) has no temporal component; membership need not match when the organization's acts occurred.
issues.respondent_position: Change in circumstances after the PDP moved toward democracy; the Abdullah and El Werfalli exception should apply to her.
issues.result_quote: There is no temporal component to the analysis contemplated in paragraph 34(1)(f) of the IRPA, whether for the organization or for its members.

issues.issue: Should the proposed question on active involvement and timing be certified?
issues.applicant_position: Question should be certified: must a member be actively involved when the organization acted, and is there a temporal component?
issues.respondent_position: Asked the Court to narrow the too-broad definition of member and reconsider the current law.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, there are no grounds to certify the proposed question.
